source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey,

[FREELANCER_NAME_005] clips have been approved and can now go live. Follow these steps exactly when publishing each clip:

**POSTING INSTRUCTIONS**

1\. On [FREELANCER_NAME_005] assigned Instagram account, upload [FREELANCER_NAME_002] clip as a Reel
2\. Include this caption with every clip:

*Follow [HANDLE_003] for more 🔥*

3\. Include all of these hashtags on every post:
#teyronalexina #personaldevelopment #entrepreneurship #mindset #motivation #selfimprovement #businessadvice #successmindset #growthmindset #ecommerce

4\. Make sure [HANDLE_003] is tagged in [FREELANCER_NAME_002] post itself, rather than only in [FREELANCER_NAME_002] caption
5\. For [FREELANCER_NAME_002] best reach, publish during peak hours, between 6pm and 9pm
6\. After posting, update [FREELANCER_NAME_002] card in Notion with [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Date Posted and [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Instagram link to [FREELANCER_NAME_002] reel

Publish all 3 clips, spacing them out at one per day for maximum reach. Do not publish all three on [FREELANCER_NAME_002] same day.

If you have any questions, message me immediately.

[CLIENT_NAME_001]

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Before I begin posting, I just wanted to confirm a couple of details:

Could you tell me which 3 clips received approval? Please send their names if possible.
Also, could you share [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Notion link (or [FREELANCER_NAME_002] exact page) where I should enter [FREELANCER_NAME_002] Date Posted and Instagram Reel link after every post?

Thanks!

ambiguity.description: The exact Notion page or card where posting dates and Reel links must be recorded has not been provided.

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to publish clips on the assigned page and send the resulting link concerns Reel publication and reporting to the client, not recording the post on the Notion card.
The statement that the clip was uploaded is an implementation claim for publication, but it does not state that the required Notion activity record was created.
